page_title: LEV 2-1 MAI | Bayer Leverkusen v Mainz 23/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Florian Wirtz is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).
89' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
85' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Tom Krauss (Mainz) is replacing Karim Onisiwo.
83' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Jeremie Frimpong and he is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
83' Substitution. Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) on for Amine Adli.
80' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Jessic Ngankam (Mainz). He’s got to go!
79' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Jessic Ngankam (Mainz)! Let's see what he decides.
79' Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
78' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
75' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Lukas Hradecky.
74' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is punished with the yellow card.
72' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough foul. Timo Gerach stops the game and makes a call.

68' 2 - 1 Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
66' Anthony Caci (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Timo Gerach and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Mainz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Substitution. Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) has come on for Brajan Gruda.
64' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
62' The corner is swung in and Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
62' The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
60' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) replacing Silvan Widmer.
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.
57' The linesman signals that Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Jonas Hofmann.
54' Robin Zentner (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
53' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
52' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Timo Gerach didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
46' Timo Gerach blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Xabi Alonso is stunned as referee Timo Gerach shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
45+1' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) duly receives a yellow card.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
42' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
41' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

40' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
39' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Jeremie Frimpong, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
37' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

36' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.

35' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.

34' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Dominik Kohr (Mainz) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
30' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

28' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
28' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
27' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
26' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
25' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) trips an opposition player and Timo Gerach signals a foul. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
24' Timo Gerach blows for a foul after Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar.
22' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.

20' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) picks the ball up and blasts it from long range without any hesitation. His shot is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reads it well and makes a fine save.
19' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
17' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

17' Great save! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Robin Zentner. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner.
16' Anthony Caci (Mainz) attempts a long-range first-time shot low towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save.
15' Timo Gerach blows his whistle after Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
14' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

13' Bayer Leverkusen are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
12' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

10' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
7' 1 - 1 GOAL 1:1! The resulting free kick is headed powerfully goalwards by Silvan Widmer and Dominik Kohr (Mainz) glances a header from close range into the back of the net.
7' A free kick to Mainz.
7' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a strong challenge and Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
5' One of the players from Mainz times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

3' 1 - 0 Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight under the crossbar. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:0.
3' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' Bayer Leverkusen take the free kick with a short pass.
2' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Bayer Leverkusen will take the kick-off.
Timo Gerach will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
